about: UCT Agent DARK corpus (Track D trading workflows, UCT_AGENT_WORKFLOWS default off). Same schema and levels as corpus.json, run by corpus.dark.test.jsx under the WHOLE catalog (testing/registry.js ALL_KINDS: every gated kind and every workflow on), never under production's config, where these capabilities do not register. Every figure the fixtures serve is synthetic.
